name: shopify-inventory
description: Prepare my Shopify inventory CSV correction from a stock count and later movements. Use when I have a Shopify inventory CSV and a physical count, need to keep recent inventory changes, or want to understand rejected correction rows. Returns a correction draft or a failed-row repair plan from pasted text, exports, and screenshots I describe. Uses dated stock evidence and keeps current-stock validation. Not for product catalog imports, forecasting, order editing, automatic store monitoring, or uploading changes to my account.
